name: Sakura Machizaka Stories Vol. 2 "Sensei ga Oshiete Ageru!"
original_name: 桜待坂Stories Vol.2「せんせいがおしえてあげる！」
source:
Main character is a popular student, but with poor grades. He will need to stay for another year if he fails next exam, so he is sent to the summer study camp. But the four hellish teachers there turn out to be small girls with superior academic abilities fit for university already. After all, this summer is going to be fun.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名广受欢迎、成绩却很差的学生。如果下次考试不及格，他就必须留级，因此被送往暑期学习集训。然而，那里的四位魔鬼教师竟然都是年幼的女孩，却拥有足以进入大学的出众学力。看来这个夏天终究会很有趣。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
